name: Case Western Reserve University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate for all students. 2026-27 tuition & fees ($71,410 tuition + $696 fees = $72,106) from case.edu/financialaid/undergraduates/cost-undergraduate-attendance and .../estimated-costs-attendance-2026-27. Housing is room only: $11,688 (first-year residential); board (meal plan) of $8,600 excluded. Excludes one-time $760 matriculation fee.
